releaseNotes: GaGa 2.7.7 is a signed re-release that ships every consolidated improvement on the current main branch: the auth fix that delivers sign-in emails, accepts link-or-code and completes account recovery; the realtime WebSocket auth fix that uses the active legacy anon key; the server-authoritative wallet ledger; the secure in-app updater (SHA-256 + size verified); the GaGa Today / China Direct shop; people sync + notifications inbox; and the SSRF-hardened link previews. IMPORTANT: this build is signed with a new release certificate, so it cannot install as an in-place update over older GaGa builds. Please uninstall the previous version once, then install 2.7.7. Future updates will install normally.
